sections.heading: Why Ethics Matters
sections.content: As AI becomes ubiquitous, we must ensure systems are fair, transparent and accountable. Ethics reduces risk and builds trust.

definitions.definition: Block unsafe user inputs (e.g., PII, abusive content)
Scan and block problematic model outputs
Log prompts/outputs for audit and improvement

sections.heading: Apply Guardrails
sections.description: Open the Cybersecurity module and review how prompt‑injection is detected. Consider adding an allow/deny list in your prompts.
steps: Draft an allow/deny list for your use case
Add a post‑filter to block banned categories
